text:
Predicates:
ListedInRecommendations(x) ::: x is listed in Yelp's recommendations.
NegativeReviews(x) ::: x has received many negative reviews.
RatingGreaterThanFour(x) ::: x has a rating greater than four.
ProvidesTakeout(x) ::: x provides take-out service.
PopularAmongLocals(x) ::: x is popular among local residents.
Premises:
∀x (ListedInRecommendations(x) → ¬NegativeReviews(x)) ::: If a restaurant is listed in Yelp's recommendations, then the restaurant has not received many negative reviews.
∀x (RatingGreaterThanFour(x) → ListedInRecommendations(x)) ::: All restaurants with a rating greater than four are listed in Yelp's recommendations.
∃x (¬ProvidesTakeout(x) ∧ NegativeReviews(x)) ::: Some restaurants that do not provide take-out service receive many negative reviews.
∀x (PopularAmongLocals(x) → RatingGreaterThanFour(x)) ::: All restaurants that are popular among local residents have ratings greater than four.
RatingGreaterThanFour(hamdenPlazaSubway) ∨ PopularAmongLocals(hamdenPlazaSubway) ::: The Hamden Plaza Subway store has a rating greater than four, or it is popular among local residents.
Conclusion:
ProvidesTakeout(hamdenPlazaSubway) ∨ ¬NegativeReviews(hamdenPlazaSubway) ::: The Hamden Plaza Subway store provides take-out service or does not receive many negative reviews.
